Subject: Solstice Retail — postmortem and evidence delivery (redacted)

Alex / Sarah — attaching our redacted postmortem and sanitized logs for the 2026-10-19 telemetry anomaly. Summary below; full artifacts attached.

Executive summary:
- Incident window: 2026-10-19 08:42:13 PT — 2026-10-19 08:55:02 PT
- Impact: elevated 500-class errors for ~0.6% of traffic from Solstice's integration; retries from client side increased latency and fanout briefly. No customer PII was involved.
- Root cause: transient memory pressure on an autoscaling worker pool during a background shard rebalance; the worker pool failed to allocate a recovery slot quickly under a brief burst pattern.

Timeline (high level):
- 08:42 PT — Anomaly detected by Solstice telemetry (client-side)
- 08:43 PT — Redwood autoscaler initiated rebalance due to reporting of increased queue depth
- 08:44–08:46 PT — A subset of workers experienced higher GC pause times, causing request timeouts 
- 08:47 PT — Autoscaler completed placement changes; retries caused a brief amplification of error rates
- 08:55 PT — Error rates returned to baseline after additional capacity evicted and retries completed

Mitigation and permanent fixes:
- Immediate: adjusted autoscaler thresholds to dampen aggressive rebalance during short bursts; increased recovery slot reservation for the affected pool.
- Short-term: deploy patch to reduce full-GC triggers in the worker process by Oct 28, 2026.
- Long-term: refactor shard rebalance logic to avoid synchronous reallocation during high client retry windows (Q1 2027).

What we are delivering (attachments / artifacts):
- ir_postmortem-solsticeretail-20261021.pdf (full postmortem, redacted)
- redacted-logs-20261019.tar.gz (sanitized traces and request id mappings)
- sigs-responses-2026-10-21.xlsx (SIG/CAIQ control mappings and short answers)

Evidence handling notes:
- Files are redacted to remove any customer-identifying metadata beyond request ids you provided.
- We can run additional filters if you identify specific request ids to exclude.
- Access: these artifacts are available at the secure upload path for 14 days; if you need longer retention we can arrange an SFTP share.

Next steps:
- Please confirm receipt and whether the artifacts meet your compliance team's needs.
- If helpful, we can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough of the postmortem with engineers (Jonas and Marissa available this week).

Ticket: HS-2241
Regards,
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
